info.title: MULTIBANCO - REST
info.description:
Welcome to the MULTIBANCO REST API documentation. This API allows you to easily generate MULTIBANCO references. To integrate with this API, you will need an 'MB KEY' provided by ifthenpay, assigned to your merchant account. If you do not have this 'MB KEY', please contact ifthenpay.
Before implementation, please verify if an existing integration is already available for your platform, whether developed by Ifthenpay, the platform provider, or a third party. You can check the list of available plugins and their corresponding e-commerce platforms [here](https://helpdesk.ifthenpay.com/pt-PT/support/solutions/articles/79000086132-plugins-para-plataformas-de-ecommerce).
ifthenpay offers free technical support to all customers through the following channels: - Email: [suporte@ifthenpay.com](suporte@ifthenpay.com) - Phone: 808 222 777 | +351 256 245 560 - Helpdesk: [submit a ticket](https://helpdesk.ifthenpay.com) - Site: [www.ifthenpay.com](https://ifthenpay.com)

expiryDays.description:
all references expire at 11:59 PM.

If the number of days provided differs from the available options, the next closest available duration will be assigned. (For example: If 155 days are requested, 180 days will be assigned until expiration).

If you prefer the reference to have no expiration date, omit the 'expiryDays' parameter in the request.
